facebookresearch_crypten/examples/meters.create_average_meter: create an AverageMeter instance to track the running average of values over time
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/meters.add_to_average_meter: add a value with an optional count to an AverageMeter and retrieve the current average
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/meters.reset_average_meter: reset an AverageMeter to clear its accumulated sum and count back to zero
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/meters.create_accuracy_meter: create an AccuracyMeter to measure top-k accuracy for multi-class classification predictions
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/meters.add_to_accuracy_meter: add model output and ground truth labels to an AccuracyMeter and retrieve top-k accuracy results

facebookresearch_crypten/examples/multip.create_multiprocess_launcher: create a MultiProcessLauncher to spawn multiple Crypten MPC processes with a given world size
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/multip.start_multiprocess_launcher: start all spawned subprocesses in the MultiProcessLauncher for parallel Crypten computation
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/multip.join_multiprocess_launcher: join all subprocesses in the MultiProcessLauncher and assert zero exit codes
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/multip.terminate_multiprocess_launcher: terminate all running subprocesses in the MultiProcessLauncher gracefully
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/multip.run_process_in_subprocess: run a user-defined function in a spawned subprocess with Crypten initialization and environment setup

facebookresearch_crypten/examples/util.p.run_kmeans_clustering: run k-means clustering on a PyTorch tensor to find K cluster centers
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/util.p.run_pca_components: run PCA on a PyTorch tensor to extract the top principal components
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/util.p.run_onehot_encoding: run one-hot encoding on a PyTorch long integer index vector
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/util.p.run_kmeans_inference: run k-means inference to compute cluster assignments for data points
facebookresearch_crypten/examples/util.p.run_process_mnist: run MNIST file processing to extract and save train and test data as .pt files
